en.titre:
10/10 hobbies to do after
work if you have adhd

colonne: sanding, cutting and gluing pull your mind away from the screen you stared at all day
en.chute: look for an evening class at a local workshop

colonne: a painting and its story gives a tired brain something new that isn't a screen or an email
_pro tip_: artura gives me one painting a day and the story behind it, in a few minutes
en.chute: five minutes on the couch, phone away

colonne: aiming takes all your attention for a second, and you see the score right away
en.chute: most pubs have a board, ask at the bar

colonne: a run after work burns off the restless energy from sitting all day, and a plan keeps it going
_pro tip_: atala builds my runs around my goal and adjusts them every week
en.chute: run before you sit down at home

colonne: the ball comes back quickly and games are short, so a tired brain still wants _one more_
en.chute: most cities have free courts and drop-in nights
